title: BuggBuzzer
tagline: BugBuzzer is token gated community platform for Developers and Organizations to Crowd source Bug Reporting, Technical Q&A forum and one on one live tech support.
description: BugBuzzer is token gated community platform for Developers and Organizations to Crowd source Bug Reporting, Technical Q&A forum and one on one live tech support. It enables developers to gain value for their expertise by giving answers in tech community forums and created token gated community to provide personal tech support to NFT holders. People can ask questions and can get the solution of their Bugs in nearest time.
how_its_made: In this project we have used solidity to create smart contract for the NFT membership which is deployed on polygon mumbai network. Used different authentication methods like web3 auth, login with Unstoppable domain, login with Worldcoin etc. Used covalent to get the number of NFTs. Stored data of ipfs.
